description: A corn farmer sends his corn to the city by either tractor or car.  A tractor can carry 40 kg of corn while a car can carry 20 kg of corn. Since tractors are very slow, the number of cars used has to be at least twice the number of tractors used. If at least 500 kg of corn need to be sent to the city, minimize the total number of tractors and cars needed.

TractorCapacity.definition: Capacity of one tractor in kilograms

CarCapacity.definition: Capacity of one car in kilograms

MinimumCarMultiplier.definition: Minimum multiplier for the number of cars relative to tractors

MinimumCornToSend.definition: Minimum total amount of corn to send in kilograms

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of tractors and cars used to transport at least 500 kg of corn to the city"

constraints.description: Total corn transported by tractors and cars must be at least MinimumCornToSend kilograms
The number of cars used must be at least MinimumCarMultiplier times the number of tractors used
The number of tractors and cars used must be non-negative integers

NumTractors.definition: Number of tractors used to transport corn

NumCars.definition: Number of cars used to transport corn
